target: v4.9.2: SF16 unit Q10.22 (32-bit, +-512), products: partial-product columns below 6 dropped, +80, cut to 22 fraction bits; SF8 unit Q18.14 (32-bit, +-131,072, exact). Chip RTL: superfloat.gpu main (and v4.9.2-openframe)

sections.mx: the chip's arithmetic: given codes and a given shift, the MX engine's output words. For sf's bit-exact MX model (test_model_matches_mxref)

mx.format: a: M x K sfN codes, b: K x 8 codes, out: M x 8 codes after POP at shift

conventions.codes: a value in Q1.(N-1): integer code q with |q| <= 2^(N-1) - 1, value = q * 2^(e - (N-1)); activations: one exponent per token (a_exp), weights: one per output channel (w_exp)
conventions.quantize: e = floor(log2 max|x|) + 1 over the slice (0 if all zero); q = round_half_even(x / 2^e * 2^(N-1)), clamped
conventions.acc_int: the accumulator after saturation, in units of 2^-frac_bits (codes as integers, sign applied); value = acc_int * 2^(a_exp + w_exp - frac_bits)
conventions.l2: pow2_exp(||a_t|| * ||w_c||) with the dequantized vectors: the exponent at which the output cannot saturate
conventions.eo: l2 - h, h from exponent_rule (margin 2), then the shift clamped to the 6-bit field
conventions.shift: POP's operand s = a_exp + w_exp - eo, signed 6 bits (-32..31), one per token and column
conventions.pop: q = round_half_even(|value| * 2^((N-1) - eo)), saturating at 2^(N-1) - 1, sign kept, -0 as 0
conventions.redo: where |pop_q| reaches 2^(N-1) - 1 (pop_saturated), the output is popped again at l2
conventions.final_code16: the word POP writes: sign at bit 15, the N-1 magnitude bits left-aligned below it
conventions.inputs: x (T x K) and w (N x K, nn.Linear layout) are exact binary fractions
